physics.where_iam_law: a loose tile is a stretch where the paid hold has failed; in mature B cells removing TET2/TET3 leaves the held level unchanged (P4, 0.987 at zero loose) but doubles the loose share (0.075 -> 0.166): whether those stretches are domains (the hold losing to division) or scattered (local erasure) decides which term of IAM-A's baseline carries a cell type's eraser (register A8, and A7's across-type part)
